name: Nanahara
source:
Affiliation: The Round Table
Bug: Rhinoceros Beetle
Ability: Rejection - My World. Nanahara wields an exoskeleton capable of projecting numerous, nigh impenetrable shields around herself and others that can also function as offensive tools due to their hardness. A bug excelling in both offense and defense.

Befitting of her bug, Nanahara has a gentle personality and is very protective of those around her and considers herself the guardian of the group's two younger members. She's also a long-time friend with Sanbara and prefers a non-aggression pact with all Corporation members, instructing both Iojaku and Hitotsuya to stay their hand as well.
